_readme: Corpus for `npm run eval:criteria`. Public GitHub issues only — the harness
fetches them unauthenticated, so private issues will simply 404 and skip.
The default set below is third-party issues chosen to span the axes that
actually stress the prompt: a concrete bug, an API-rename that names real
symbols, a scoped feature request, a sprawling issue that tempts
out-of-scope criteria, a near-empty body, and a title-only issue.
`repoRoot` is optional and points at a LOCAL checkout of that same repo. It
makes the harness synthesise an approximate file index (leading comments +
regex-extracted exports, no API cost) and feed it as `repo_context` — the
only way to exercise the `invented_from_context` failure mode. Pair it only
with issues from that repo; feeding one project's issue another project's
For a real pre-ship check, replace these with issues from YOUR repos and set
repoRoot on each, so the eval measures the prompt on the codebases it will

issues.note: concrete bug, clear repro — the easy case; criteria should be tight
detailed bug with spec references — tempts over-long criteria
names a real exported symbol — checks the path/export hint path
scoped feature request; a UI ask that tempts not_pr_verifiable
long and sprawling — the main out_of_scope risk
vague, almost no content — should yield few criteria or none
empty body, title only — must NOT invent requirements
